newsitem.title: USA: 17-year-old arrested in slaying of Seattle family.
newsitem.headline: 17-year-old arrested in slaying of Seattle family.

text.p: Police said Friday they have arrested a suspect in the slaying of a family of four that has shocked residents in a normally quiet Seattle suburb.
Bellevue Police Lt. Bill Ferguson said a "17-year-old Bellevue youth" was arrested late Thursday as police were trying to calm fears at a neighbourhood meeting with several hundred people.
Ferguson declined to give further details ahead of a news conference planned for later in the day.

William Wilson, 52, his wife, Rosalie, 46, and their daughter Julia, 17, were found stabbed and bludgeoned to death in their house Sunday, shortly after the body of their other daughter, Kimberly, 20, was found strangled in a nearby park.

The arrest came as police met with about 400 people who packed an elementary school to learn more about the case. Police said the slaying was not random, not drug-related and not a professional "hit."
They also said the house, in an upper-middle class subdivision, had not been ransacked.
The town of 90,000 people across Lake Washington from Seattle had only three homicides in all of 1996.
